description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'AbstractInstallerController' within the OrangeHRM project. It provides common functionalities for handling HTTP responses and requests during the installation process, including response management, path checking, and access control based on installation status.

classes.name: AbstractInstallerController
classes.description: An abstract controller class for managing installation-related HTTP request processing and response handling in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getNewResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Response object.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Retrieves the current response object, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the response object; accepts Response, RedirectResponse, or null.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main entry point for handling an HTTP request during installation, with access control based on installation state.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to process the request.
